results.test_desc: Client certificate authentication should not be used for users(Manual)
results.audit: Review user access to the cluster and ensure that users are not making use of Kubernetes client certificate authentication.
results.remediation: Alternative mechanisms provided by Kubernetes such as the use of OIDC should beimplemented in place of client certificates.
test_info: Alternative mechanisms provided by Kubernetes such as the use of OIDC should beimplemented in place of client certificates.
